q.line: And you'll fall asleep counting your blessings
stanza: I think about a nursery and I picture curly heads
And one by one I count them as they slumber in their beds
If you're worried and you can't sleep
Just count your blessings instead of sheep
And you'll fall asleep counting your blessings

partner.line: And one by one I count them as they slumber in their beds

q.line: Time for them lessons, time for them blessings
